rationale: Cash-only residual from ICI Table 39: Paid dividends total minus Reinvested dividends total. Paid total already includes reinvested dividends; cash = paid - reinvested.

Table 39 paid-dividends total, interpreted as total investor distributions including reinvested dividends. Identity: paid total = cash distributions + reinvested dividends; paid + reinvested would double-count.

Model-comparable public construction: monthly sum of MMF assets times asset-weighted 7-day net yield divided by 12. Base uses avg prior/current month-end assets and avg prior/current month-end net yields; low/high use prior vs current month-end yield on avg assets to bracket timing in a rising/falling rate month.
